name: etsy-product-ideas-dam
description: Canva DAM app showing AI-generated Etsy product concepts from the moltbot daily automation.
_setup_notes: This app uses the Canva Apps SDK starter kit build system.
To develop/build, clone the starter kit and copy src/ into a new example:
Or use the setup.sh script in this directory which does the above automatically.
CANVA_APP_ID must be set in the starter kit's .env file (get it from canva.com/developers).
